description: Java class 'AuthenticationServerClient' that provides methods to authenticate users via AMQP 1.0 protocol, including verifying credentials and retrieving tokens from an authentication service.

classes.name: AuthenticationServerClient
classes.description: A Java class for authenticating users via AMQP 1.0, supporting credential verification and token retrieval.

methods.name: AuthenticationServerClient
methods.description: Constructor initializing the client with Vertx instance and connection factory.

methods.name: verifyExternal
methods.description: Attempts to verify a user using SASL EXTERNAL, currently always fails due to unsupported mechanism.

methods.name: verifyPlain
methods.description: Verifies username/password credentials via AMQP 1.0, retrieves a token if successful.

methods.name: mapConnectionFailureToServiceInvocationException
methods.description: Maps connection failure causes to specific service invocation exceptions.

methods.name: getToken
methods.description: Handles token retrieval from the authentication service after establishing a connection.

methods.name: openReceiver
methods.description: Opens a Proton receiver link to the authentication service and sets up message handling.
